title: No Rain Client [BTW Addon]
description: No Rain Addon is a simple server-side addon for Minecraft Better Than Wolves that allows you to disable rain for a configurable amount of time or permanently.
body:
This addon is intended for players who want clearer visibility or improved performance during rainy weather.

# Features
- Disables rain rendering
- Removes rain particles and visual effects
- Improves visibility during storms
- Lightweight client-side addon
- Compatible with multiplayer servers

# Note
This addon only affects visuals on the client and does not modify world weather behavior server-side.
